content.text: {"window_id":"w0015","observed_failures":[{"id":"F1","description":"total_amount wrong for 074.jpg: predicted 702.00 but OCR shows the correct 'Total incl. of GST 102.00' line; a corrupted 'Total Amt Rounded ——S«702.00' variant was accepted via voting.","evidence":"predictions row 074.jpg total_amount=702.00; debug trace shows variant 0 picked 702.00, variants 1/2 saw 102.00; feedback marks amount_correct=false"},{"id":"F2","description":"total_amount wrong for 077.jpg: predicted 23.26 instead of final rounded TOTAL 23.25 that appears as the last keyword line.","evidence":"OCR of 077.jpg shows 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26','Rounding Adj: -0.01','TOTAL: 23.25'; prediction 23.26; feedback amount_correct=false"},{"id":"F3","description":"date wrong for 034.jpg: predicted 2018-08-09 but receipt clearly shows 09/03/2018 (DD/MM/YYYY).","evidence":"OCR 'Date: 09/03/2018'; prediction date=2018-08-09; feedback date_correct=false"},{"id":"F4","description":"total_amount for 078.jpg left blank/null even though receipt shows Grand Total 92.80.","evidence":"predictions row 078.jpg total_amount=''; OCR variant 0 cleanly reads 'Grand Total 92.80'; feedback amount_correct=false"},{"id":"F5","description":"Agent exhausted 65 iterations (max_iterations) debugging multi-pass voting without converging; termination_reason='max_iterations', iteration_limit_reached=true.","evidence":"execution_metadata.termination_reason='max_iterations'; agent_iterations=65; 65 model turns largely spent in OCR trial-and-error"}],"root_causes":[{"id":"R1","description":"Voting across OCR variants trusts noisy variants equally: a single corrupted upscaled read ('702.00','688.17','100.00','23.25') can override cleaner reads. Priority tier is applied per-variant before cross-variant consensus, so a lower-quality variant that happens to match a higher-priority keyword wins over higher-quality variants matching a lower tier.","related_failures":["F1","F2","F4"]},{"id":"R2","description":"Keyword fallback to the 'next non-empty line' is applied unconditionally when a tier-matched line has no number; it does not exclude lines that are clearly payment/change/visa/cash-received, so noise lines like 'Visa RM =688.17' become the chosen total.","related_failures":["F1"]},{"id":"R3","description":"Within a tier, the implementation prefers the LAST matching line, but for receipts with a rounded 'Total' line followed by a 'Grand Total' or final 'TOTAL:' line, cross-variant disagreement is resolved by frequency rather than by picking the lexically latest keyword occurrence or the strictly highest-priority keyword present in the cleanest variant.","related_failures":["F2","F4"]},{"id":"R4","description":"Date parsing has no locale heuristic: when both '09/03/2018' and '08/09' style numbers appear nearby (e.g., time stamps, item codes), the parser can match the wrong triple and does not re-score candidates by proximity to 'Date' / 'DATE' tokens or by DD/MM/YYYY preference for Malaysian receipts.","related_failures":["F3"]},{"id":"R5","description":"The pipeline lacks a disciplined, bounded strategy: Skill guidance encourages multi-pass OCR but gives no explicit stopping rule, cross-variant arbitration rule, or sanity checks (e.g., total must be <= cash tendered + change, must appear in >=2 variants when possible). This leads the agent into open-ended tuning loops.","related_failures":["F5","F1","F2","F4"]},{"id":"R6","description":"image-ocr Skill does not specify how to combine priority tiers with multi-pass OCR or how to reject payment-line fallbacks; agent re-invented a brittle voting scheme from scratch inside one run.","related_failures":["F1","F2","F4","F5"]}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Multi-pass OCR section recommends combining text from several variants but gives no deterministic arbitration rule for conflicting field values; no guidance to prefer the variant with the highest-priority keyword tier AND most repeated numeric value, nor to abstain when variants disagree with no majority."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Total-extraction rules do not restrict the two-line fallback: they allow falling through to any non-excluded next line, which lets payment lines (Visa/Cash/Card) masquerade as totals. Exclusions list is not expanded with payment keywords like VISA, MASTERCARD, PAYMENT, TENDER, RECEIVED."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Within-tier tie-breaking is under-specified. The skill should state: 'If multiple lines in the same priority tier match, prefer the one appearing LAST in reading order AND whose numeric value also appears on an immediately preceding/following summary line (sanity check), unless a stricter keyword (GRAND TOTAL, final TOTAL:) occurs later.'"},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date extraction lacks a locality rule: it does not instruct to anchor the match to a 'Date' / 'DATE' / 'Tarikh' label when present, nor to prefer DD/MM/YYYY for receipts with 'RM' currency, nor to reject year/month/day triples that overlap with timestamps or invoice numbers."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No explicit iteration/complexity budget: the skill does not advise capping OCR variants (e.g., 2-3) and committing after a sanity-checked result, nor does it tell the agent to abstain (null) rather than keep searching once a confident candidate exists."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Quality self-check list omits concrete numeric sanity checks for receipts: total should not equal cash tendered or change; total should not be a payment-method amount; if a Rounding Adj line follows a provisional total, prefer the FINAL rounded TOTAL line."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"xlsx guidance does not specifically remind that for OCR output pipelines the amount column must be written as string with trailing zeros preserved and that empty extractions must be written as empty cells (None), not as empty string ''. One prediction row shows total_amount='' which is a schema violation."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No cross-field consistency rule: when OCR confidence for either field is low, the skill should suggest returning null for that field rather than guessing, which would raise field_accuracy over joint accuracy for ambiguous receipts."}],"repair_recommendations":[{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'Multi-pass Arbitration' subsection: run exactly 2-3 OCR variants (default, autocontrast grayscale PSM 6, optional 2x upscale PSM 6). For each variant compute (tier_index, value). Final choice: (a) pick the smallest tier_index observed across variants; (b) within that tier, pick the value with the highest multiplicity; (c) break ties by preferring the value that also appears somewhere in another variant's text (even outside a keyword line); (d) if no value repeats across variants AND tier_index > 1, return null rather than guess."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Expand EXCLUSIONS to also cover payment/tender lines: add 'VISA','MASTERCARD','DEBIT','CREDIT','PAYMENT','TENDER','TENDERED','RECEIVED','CARD','CASH RECEIVED','BALANCE','ROUNDING'. Specify that during the two-line fallback, the fallback line must still pass the exclusion filter; otherwise skip and continue to the next tier candidate instead of accepting it."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Formalize within-tier selection: 'If a tier matches multiple lines, scan the lines bottom-to-top; prefer the match whose numeric value equals or follows an earlier line with the same keyword (confirming a final rounded total). If a strictly higher-priority keyword (GRAND TOTAL / final TOTAL:) exists later in the document, prefer that over an earlier same-tier match.'"},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Rewrite the Date Extraction section to: (1) first search for lines containing 'DATE', 'TARIKH', 'INVOICE DATE', 'BILL DATE' and only parse date patterns on those lines or the next non-empty one; (2) default to DD/MM/YYYY for 2-digit-first patterns, YYYY-MM-DD when year is 4 digits first; (3) reject matches that are substrings of longer digit runs (invoice numbers, barcodes); (4) if multiple candidate dates disagree across OCR variants, pick the one that appears in >=2 variants; else null."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add an explicit Budget & Stopping Rule: 'Do not run more than 3 OCR variants per image. After arbitration, do not retry OCR unless both fields are null. Prefer returning null for a field over spending additional turns tuning preprocessing.' This directly addresses iteration exhaustion."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add Numeric Sanity Checks: (a) reject totals equal to CASH or CHANGE or payment-method amount on the same receipt; (b) if a 'Rounding Adj' line is present, prefer the TOTAL line that appears AFTER it; (c) reject totals whose integer part has >5 digits unless currency symbol confirms (filters OCR glitches like 702.00 vs 102.00 — require a corroborating same-value elsewhere in the text)."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Clarify null-emission contract: 'When writing to tabular output, failed extractions MUST be Python None (empty cell), never empty string, never NaN text, never 0. total_amount MUST be a string formatted with f\"{v:.2f}\" or None.' Include a short code snippet showing object-dtype column and None preservation."},{"target_skill":"xlsx","change":"Add a short 'OCR output tables' note: emphasize using pandas with object dtype for monetary strings, writing None (not '') for missing values, and sorting rows lexicographically by filename. Reference image-ocr skill for formatting rules so pipelines stay consistent."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'Common Receipt Pitfalls' subsection listing concrete failure modes seen in practice: upscaling can corrupt digits ('102'→'702', '88'→'688'); payment lines mimic totals; rounding-adjusted totals differ from pre-rounding totals; dates often appear in DD/MM/YY near store footer. Provide one-sentence mitigation for each — these generalize beyond this specific run."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Recommend a lightweight self-consistency check function (pseudocode) that, given extracted (date, total) and the raw OCR text, verifies: total string appears verbatim in >=1 variant; date components appear on a labeled line; otherwise downgrades the field to null. Encourage calling it before writing the row."}],"confidence":0.78}
